summary: All plan items for issue #304 (host-port collision detection at dispatch time) are implemented and tested. The error class, repository method, service-layer check, and HTTP 409 route handler are all present. 11 unit tests cover collision, no-collision, terminal exclusion, multi-port, multi-companion, idempotent replay, terminal statuses, and edge cases. Validation evidence in plans/ISSUE_304_VALIDATION.md confirms 11/11 tests pass, ruff and mypy pass, and openapi drift check passes.
